verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for a SaaS research platform that holds user libraries and imported papers. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where data is stored. The closest item is organization-level centralized account and billing management, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
